texts.title: The Canvass
texts.body: {self.name}'s name is down for the election, and now it must be carried round: to the houses, to the benches, to the men who are owed and the men who owe. A candidate who does not ask is assumed not to want it.

choices.spend_a_little: Spend a little where it will be remembered.

texts.title: The Count Goes Your Way
texts.body: The tellers have finished. {self.name} is elected, and for five years will hold an office of the Reach in {self.name}'s own name and not the house's. It is one rung. There are others above it, and people already asking which {self.name} will want next.

texts.title: The Count Goes Against You
texts.body: The tellers have finished, and it is not {self.name}. The houses were asked and chose someone else. There will be another election in five years, and {self.name} will be five years older at it.

choices.learn_who_did_not_vote: Learn who did not vote as they promised.
choices.say_you_never_wanted_it: Say you never much wanted it.

texts.title: One Of Yours Is Elected
texts.body: {kin.name} stood, on {kin.name}'s own decision, and the houses have chosen {kin.name}. For five years one of {self.name}'s own will sit as a magistrate of the Reach. {kin.name} did the asking, and {kin.name} won it.

choices.remind_them_whose_name_they_carry: Remind them whose name they carry.

texts.title: The Aedile's Games
texts.body: The city expects games of its aediles, and remembers for a generation which were good. {self.name} has the office, the season is coming, and the contractors are waiting to hear what kind of games these are to be.

choices.something_the_city_has_not_seen: Something the city has not seen.
choices.spend_it_on_the_drains: Spend it on the drains instead.

texts.title: The One You Did Not Speak For
texts.body: {kin.name} stood for office, and lost, and has come to say what the whole house already knows: that {self.name} did not go to one door for them. Others had their head at their shoulder all through the canvass. {kin.name} had a name on a list.

choices.say_you_will_next_time: Say you will speak for them next time, and mean it.
choices.tell_them_an_office_is_earned: Tell them an office is earned, not handed down.
choices.make_it_up_to_them: Make it up to them out of your own purse.

texts.title: Your Name in the Scandal
texts.body: It has come out. The money that found its way to {self.name} in office has been followed back, and the Senate has taken the office away. For five years {self.name} may not stand for anything. What remains is what is said about it.

choices.say_nothing_and_wait: Say nothing, and wait for it to pass.
choices.pay_it_back_in_the_open: Pay it back in the open.
choices.say_they_all_do_it: Say that they all do it.

texts.title: One of Yours Is Removed
texts.body: {kin.name} took money in office, and it has come out, and the Senate has taken the office away. It was {kin.name}'s office and {kin.name}'s doing. It is the house's name in the mouths of the benches all the same.

choices.stand_beside_them: Stand beside them where it can be seen.
choices.say_it_was_theirs_alone: Say it was theirs alone, and that the house condemns it.
choices.pay_it_back_for_them: Pay it back for them, quietly.

texts.title: The Court Finds for You
texts.body: The praetor has ruled, and the ruling is for the house. Damages have been paid over. It is a small sum and a larger satisfaction, and the other house will remember who sat on the bench.

texts.title: The Court Finds Against You
texts.body: The praetor has ruled against the house, and damages have been paid out of the treasury. Whether the law was read straight or bent is a thing the house may have its own opinion about. The ruling stands either way.

choices.say_the_bench_was_bought: Say in the Senate that the bench was bought.
